scope: Independent read-only source/math review plus reproducible invented controls
reviewed_items: Full-interval speed bounds for direct and turning branches
Reflection of left turning layers and source-normal derivative signs
Interior critical guides and finite normal/transverse domain
Vertical and whole-interval constant velocity cases
Critical boundaries, equal maxima and branch-specific tied derivatives
limitations: Candidate-family sufficiency for minimum time is not finite enumeration of every geometrically distinct ray; equal-max guides can form a continuum.
Floating-point time ordering is not an interval minimum-time certificate.
No production solver or synthetic truth was replaced.
